description: The manifest's compiled headless suites and the Apple-only suites (apple-uikit-device) on a physical Apple TV (arm64, the tvOS product profile's toolchain, SDK and deployment target). tools/quality/ios_conformance.py --device-profile tvos-arm64-device builds them against build-tvos (./build-tvos-app.sh configures it) exactly as the iOS profile does against build-ios, installs the host app with ios-deploy.sh --device tv and launches it once per suite through devicectl. The GPU suites are not hosted: they present through a window the Apple TV host has not been validated with. The benchmark programs (physics_bench.py, scheduler_budgets.py) stay iOS-only.

unsupported.shared-unit: builds a first-party shared library at run time; the iOS profile links first-party code statically and loads no first-party module
unsupported.sanitizer: needs a sanitizer runtime the iOS profile does not ship (TSan runs on the Linux lanes)
unsupported.libstdcxx-dual-abi: seeds a libstdc++ dual-ABI mismatch (_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI); the iOS toolchain's libc++ has one ABI, so the seeded defect cannot exist there

platform_defines._comment: Suite rows that declare Linux platform defines compile with the tvOS product's instead (wscript's iOS-family defines with PLATFORM_TVOS): the code the app ships.

include_after_comment: ARM targets find sse2neon.h (public/mathlib/ssemath.h) in common/, as the product's targets include it; searched last so it shadows nothing.

unsupported_suites._comment: Suites whose sources call an API the tvOS SDK marks unavailable.
unsupported_suites.platform.sequence_checker: forks a child to prove PLATFORM_CHECK_SEQUENCE aborts; fork is unavailable on tvOS (the iOS profile runs it)
